Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The left-turn, U-turn and multiple-turn-lane pages each include an example diagram that has no extractable text; only the printed rules were used, and no diagram content is described [A01].
The U-turn page says the turn is allowed at some intersections without naming which, so only the posted-sign check and the rural two-lane rule are stated as rules [A02].
The multiple turn lane example on this page is a left-turn diagram; the right-turn rule for four-lane roads is restated exactly as printed [A03].
The hill parking page labels its diagram with uphill and downhill captions only; the downhill rule is printed without a curb distinction and is restated that way [A06].
Whether a given intersection allows a U-turn depends on local signs, which is isolated as dynamic.
